Foreword It is a matter of great pleasure to write few words about the Practical Text Book upractical Chemistry". The book illustrates the principle involved in the experiment and lucidly explains the process. It is a well written book and is useful for the HSEB Class XI and XII students as well as the PCL students. The authors have done their best in presenting the subject matter in simple and comprehensive way. They have explained the experiments on the basis of their long teaching experiences in the laboratory as well as the theory classes. I believe chat the student community as well as the teachers involved in teaching chemistry will find this book useful and interesting.
Finally, I wish the success of the authors in their professionalism and I wish the success of this book as well.
Jaya Krishna Shrestha Professor Central Department of Chemistry Tribhuvan University Kirtipur, Kathmandu, Nepal

Foreword It is the matter of great pleasure for having a book "Practical Chemistry" which, I believe, should be a useful textbook of chemistry for the practical courses. It 'J appears that this book has been written in accordance with the HSEB syllabus of Grade XI and XII. The book is expected to be equally useful for the students of Proficiency Certificate Level.

The authors have done their best in presenting the subject matter in a lucid, interesting and precise manner. This book enables the to understand the subject matter more clearly, because each experiment described in the book includes well explained theory and procedure as well as clear diagram, observations and precautions. The "Suggested Works" provided at the bottom of the each of the experiment is expected to inspire the learners to perform similar kinds of new experiments.
It is my belief that this book will be received by teaching and learning communities of our country. Finally, I congratulate the authors for producing a fine book.
Professor Mohan Bikram Gewali Executive Director Research Centre for Applied Science and Technology (RECAST)

Preface It gives us immense pleasure to present this book "Practical Chemistry" of the Buddha's Practical Series. This book is applicable to the students of Grade XI & as well as those of Proficiency Certificate Level of Science. This book has mainly been designated according to the syllabus of Higher Secondary Education Board (HSEB), Nepal. It endeavours to provide a complete material as a text book of the practical courses. This book has basically been prepared as per the teaching and laboratory experiences of the authors. The problems plus the errors that are being faced frequently by the teachers and the students in many of the experiments have been tried out to be eliminated. Valuable suggestions from the persons related to the academic field in chemistry have been included in this book as far as possible.

Dealing with the experiments in a comprehensive and lucid manner is the chief feature of this book. The theory and the procedure are explained more clearly in presence of the self-explanatory diagrams. All the essential reactions and precautions to be taken concerned to the experiment are mentioned. The experiments are also believed to be helpful for the course content of the theory paper. In addition, each experiment is accompanied with "Suggested Works" which are similar to the concerned experiment.
